bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/notification.rs, process_info.rs, locale.rs, intents.rs, control.rs, runtime.rs
summary: Notifications, process activity tracking, localized bundles and App Intents have SDK counterparts. Progress reporting, error types, XPC-style app extensions and AppleScript-like scripting have no general API; apps use the control socket RPC instead.

features.feature: Task Management (ProcessInfo activities, sudden termination, thermal state, user activities)
features.note: Activity tracker, sudden termination and thermal state exist; continue_activity handles Spotlight activities. No Progress/ProgressManager tree or Handoff.
Bundle::load and localized! cover strings (en, is). No on-demand resource requests or general bundle resource lookup API documented.
add_observer/post with sender object and cross-app distributed posts through the shell; user info is string-only; no NotificationQueue coalescing.
Share and Spotlight/intents hooks exist between apps and shell; no generic extension host or item provider API.
Per-module Rust error enums only; no NSError-style domain/code/userInfo type or recovery attempter.
JSON-RPC control sockets let scripts and agents drive apps (bifrost pc control). No scripting dictionaries, AppleScript engine or user script tasks.

gaps: NSError-style error type with domains and user info
Generic app extension host and NSItemProvider
NotificationQueue coalescing and typed notification payloads
